- SLA exception for PGW routing under 1% tail (ticketed) — owner: Vivek (ops runbook + mitigation).

- Exec ask: approval to allocate 2 additional dedicated GPU nodes for pilot — decision needed by 08/07.
- Open: Risk note on private deployment onboarding docs for Orbit Health (security artifacts outstanding).

1) Marissa — confirm ProcureCo milestone dates for contract signature and initial invoice (ETA and blocker).
2) Vivek — add mitigation steps to SLA_exception_log_2028-07.csv and estimate rollout time.

4) Marissa + Karthik — coordinate legal/finance to confirm whether we can present the pilot capacity ask in QBR.
5) All — review QBR_preflight_checklist_v2.xlsx and mark status column by EOD Thurs (08/03).

Notes: if you need me to escalate to Aditya for quick sign-off, call it out in your reply.

Thanks,

Karthik/Marissa — taking SLA exception item. I've triaged the PGW routing tail issue: root cause is a misrouted retry policy causing hot shards under a specific traffic fanout. Short-term mitigation: adjust retry window and add prefix KV cache bypass for the faulty path. Medium-term: split routing table and add a circuit breaker (2 weeks).

I've appended mitigation steps and ETA to SLA_exception_log_2028-07.csv (rows 14-17) and flagged the risk for the QBR slide. Expect rollout in our staging cluster by 08/04 and prod by 08/11 (after smoke test).

If we want to reduce the decision friction for the pilot capacity (2 nodes), we should present the mitigation and the fallback policy; that will make execs comfortable to approve short-term capacity.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Infrastructure & Reliability
[vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com]
